Package com.robojacks.lib.drive

package com.robojacks.lib.drive
  • Class
    Description
    DifferentialDrive
    Arcade/tank drive helper, same methods as WPILib's DifferentialDrive.
    DriveDistance
    Drives straight a set distance (negative = backward) while holding the starting heading.
    DriveGains
    Tuning numbers the library's drive commands use.
    DriveToPoint
    Drives to a FIELD point (meters, center origin) using odometry.
    FeedforwardCharacterization
    Measures the drivetrain's feedforward: volts = kS + kV * speed + kA * accel.
    TankDriveSubsystem
    What the library's drive commands (TurnToHeading, DriveToPoint, DriveDistance and the tuning tests) need from your drivetrain.
    TuningCommands
    Tests that dial in the drivetrain constants without writing code.
    TurnAutoTune
    Finds turn PID gains automatically with a relay (bang-bang) test.
    TurnToHeading
    Turns in place to a FIELD heading (CCW-positive, 0 = +X).
